Class GUIView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.GUIView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelObserver
public class GUIView extends Object implements ModelObserver
JavaFX-based GUI view that implements ModelObserver. Receives callbacks from ClientModel and updates the graphical interface by switching scenes (lobby → waiting → game → end-game) and delegating fine-grained rendering to GameScreen.
